onboarding.language.title.description: Heading of the very first onboarding screen: the language picker.

onboarding.language.subtitle.value: You can change this anytime in Settings.
onboarding.language.subtitle.description: Reassurance line under the language picker heading.

onboarding.action.continue.description: Primary forward-navigation button used across onboarding screens.

onboarding.welcome.skip.description: Skips the welcome carousel and jumps straight to sign-in.

onboarding.welcome.next.description: Advances the welcome carousel to the next slide.

onboarding.welcome.get_started.description: Final button on the last welcome-carousel slide; proceeds to sign-in.

onboarding.welcome.slide1.title.value: All your bookings on one calendar
onboarding.welcome.slide1.title.description: Title of welcome carousel slide 1 (booking calendar pitch).

onboarding.welcome.slide1.body.value: See every event at a glance and never miss a payment — as easy as WhatsApp.
onboarding.welcome.slide1.body.description: Body of welcome carousel slide 1. WhatsApp is a permitted integration name.

onboarding.welcome.slide2.title.value: A simple ledger for every party
onboarding.welcome.slide2.title.description: Title of welcome carousel slide 2 (expenses ledger pitch).

onboarding.welcome.slide2.body.value: Track money you gave and got, person by person, with receipts attached.

onboarding.welcome.slide3.title.description: Title of welcome carousel slide 3 (offline-first pitch).

onboarding.welcome.slide3.body.value: Everything is saved on your phone and syncs automatically when you are back online.

onboarding.signin.subtitle.value: Sign in to keep your data safe across devices.
onboarding.signin.subtitle.description: Reassurance line under the sign-in heading during onboarding.

onboarding.fork.title.value: How would you like to start?
onboarding.fork.title.description: Heading of the create-vs-join fork screen after sign-in.

onboarding.fork.create.description: Fork option: start a brand-new business (owner path).

onboarding.fork.create_body.value: Set up your hall or venue from scratch.
onboarding.fork.create_body.description: Supporting line under the create-a-business fork option.

onboarding.fork.join.description: Fork option: join an existing business via an invitation (employee path).

onboarding.fork.join_body.value: Work in a business you were invited to.
onboarding.fork.join_body.description: Supporting line under the join-a-business fork option.

onboarding.fork.invite_badge.value: {count, plural, one {# invitation waiting} other {# invitations waiting}}
onboarding.fork.invite_badge.description: Badge on the join option when pending invitations were auto-detected. ICU plural; count = number of invitations.

onboarding.join.invited_as.description: Subtitle on an invitation row; {name} is the display name the owner assigned to this member.

onboarding.join.accept.description: Button on an invitation row that accepts the invite and enters that business.

onboarding.join.accept_failed.value: Couldn't accept the invitation. Check your connection and try again.
onboarding.join.accept_failed.description: Error shown on the invitation screen when accepting an invitation fails (offline, or the server refused the activation).

onboarding.join.empty.value: No invitations found for your email yet. Ask the owner to invite you, then try again.
onboarding.join.empty.description: Empty state on the invitation screen when no pending invitation exists for the signed-in email.

onboarding.join.refresh.description: Button that re-fetches memberships/invitations from the server.

onboarding.create.name_label.description: Label of the required business-name field on the create-business form.

onboarding.create.name_required.description: Validation error when the business name is left empty.

onboarding.create.type_label.description: Label of the business-type dropdown (suggestions + free text).

onboarding.create.address_label.description: Label of the optional address field on the create-business form.

onboarding.create.owner_label.description: Label of the required owner-name field on the create-business form.

onboarding.create.owner_required.description: Validation error when the owner name is left empty.

onboarding.create.logo_label.description: Label of the optional logo section on the create-business form.

onboarding.create.logo_camera.description: Button that opens the camera to capture a business logo.

onboarding.create.logo_gallery.description: Button that opens the photo picker to select a business logo.

onboarding.create.logo_preview.description: Accessibility description of the cropped logo preview image.

onboarding.create.submit.description: Submit button of the create-business form.

onboarding.create.error.value: Could not save your business. Please try again.
onboarding.create.error.description: Generic error when persisting the new business fails.

onboarding.business_type.marriage_hall.description: Business-type suggestion in the create-business dropdown.

onboarding.business_type.banquet_hall.description: Business-type suggestion in the create-business dropdown.

onboarding.business_type.community_hall.description: Business-type suggestion in the create-business dropdown.

onboarding.business_type.guest_house.description: Business-type suggestion in the create-business dropdown.

onboarding.business_type.other.description: Business-type suggestion for a custom, free-text type.

onboarding.link_google.title.description: Heading of the optional Google-linking onboarding step.

onboarding.link_google.body.value: Connect Google for Calendar sync and Drive backup. You can do this anytime from Settings.
onboarding.link_google.body.description: Explanation on the Google-linking step; linking is optional and relinkable from Settings.

onboarding.link_google.connect.description: Button that starts Google account linking (Calendar/Drive scopes).

onboarding.link_google.later.description: Prominent secondary action that skips Google linking and finishes onboarding.

auth.sign_up.title.description: Heading of the email sign-up form (toggled from the sign-in screen).

auth.sign_up.submit.description: Submit button of the email sign-up form.

auth.sign_up.error.value: Could not create the account. Try a different email or a longer password.
auth.sign_up.error.description: Generic error shown when email+password sign-up is rejected.

auth.mode.to_sign_up.description: Link that switches the auth form from sign-in to sign-up mode.

auth.mode.to_sign_in.value: Already have an account? Sign in
auth.mode.to_sign_in.description: Link that switches the auth form from sign-up back to sign-in mode.

auth.google.not_configured.value: Google sign-in isn't set up yet
auth.google.not_configured.description: Disabled-state label on the Google button when no Google client ID is configured in this build.

auth.error.network.value: Could not connect. Check your internet and try again.
auth.error.network.description: Error shown when an auth call fails due to network problems.

auth.permissions.presets_label.description: Label above the Viewer/Staff/Manager preset chips on the permission matrix editor.

auth.permissions.preset_viewer.description: Permission preset chip: every view permission, nothing else.

auth.permissions.preset_staff.description: Permission preset chip: view + create permissions.

auth.permissions.preset_manager.description: Permission preset chip: everything except settings/members.

auth.permissions.group_booking.description: Permission matrix group header for booking capabilities.

auth.permissions.group_expenses.description: Permission matrix group header for expenses capabilities.

auth.permissions.group_inventory.description: Permission matrix group header for inventory capabilities.

auth.permissions.group_reports.description: Permission matrix group header for reports capabilities.

auth.permissions.group_settings.description: Permission matrix group header for settings capabilities.

auth.permissions.action_view.description: Permission toggle: see this tab's content.

auth.permissions.action_create.description: Permission toggle: create new records in this tab.

auth.permissions.action_edit.description: Permission toggle: edit existing records in this tab.

auth.permissions.action_delete.description: Permission toggle: delete (tombstone) records in this tab.

auth.permissions.action_record_payment.description: Permission toggle: record payments against bookings and act on payment reminders.

auth.permissions.action_generate_invoice.description: Permission toggle: generate and share booking invoices.

auth.permissions.action_manage_parties.description: Permission toggle: add and edit ledger parties.

auth.permissions.action_manage_master_it.description: Permission toggle: add, edit and delete inventory master items.

auth.permissions.action_manage_business.description: Permission toggle: edit business profile, logo, invoice prefix and business settings.

auth.permissions.action_manage_members.description: Permission toggle: invite, edit and revoke members.

auth.permissions.action_gcal_sync.description: Permission toggle: enable and manage Google Calendar sync.

auth.permissions.action_view_amounts.description: Permission toggle (row appears under Booking, Expenses, Inventory and Reports): see financial amounts in this tab. ON by default — an absent key means amounts stay visible; the owner switches it OFF explicitly to hide them, and the app then masks every figure as ₹•••.

auth.permissions.amount_hidden_a11y.description: Accessibility label (screen readers only, never rendered visually) announced wherever a masked amount is shown as ₹••• because the member's view_amounts permission is off.

onboarding.sign_in.continue_offline.description: Sign-in screen escape hatch (offline-first): proceeds to business setup in device-local owner mode; data syncs once the user signs in later.
